findings.current: “Some very grateful person gave it to me before he left.”
findings.defect: “Very grateful person” makes the giver feel gratitude, whereas the Korean describes him ironically as someone worthy of the narrator’s gratitude.
findings.rationale: 고마우신 분 characterizes the giver as someone the speaker is grateful to, not as someone who is himself grateful.
findings.replacement: “Some generous soul gave it to me before he left.”

findings.defect: The imperative “Acquire” does not match the source’s nominal description of the item’s effect.
findings.rationale: 습득 is presented as the resulting acquisition of the technique, not as a command to the reader.

findings.current: It was suspicious enough that Jopil had been living as a wandering martial artist despite having mastered a Supreme Peak martial art.
findings.defect: “Mastered” overstates Jopil’s proficiency; the source says only that he learned the martial art.
findings.rationale: 익힌 establishes acquisition or training, not full mastery, which matters because Jopil’s unexpectedly poor ability is the mystery under discussion.
findings.replacement: It was suspicious enough that Jopil had been living as a wandering martial artist despite having learned a Supreme Peak martial art.
findings.source: 초절정 무공을 익힌 조필이 낭인 짓을 하고 있다는 것부터가 수상하긴 하다.

findings.current: “Count the fingers on your hands and feet. How many are there altogether?”
findings.rationale: 손, 발가락 refers to the fingers and toes whose combined total is twenty.
findings.replacement: “Count your fingers and toes. How many are there altogether?”
findings.source: “네 손, 발가락을 합해 봐라. 모두 몇 개냐?”

findings.defect: The draft adds strong profanity absent from the mild, astonished exclamation in the source.
findings.rationale: 오우야 expresses surprised awe here without the vulgar force of “Holy shit.”

findings.current: It wasn’t those Three Saints, but whatever.
findings.defect: The translation loses the explicit Korean pun between 삼성, the title just mentioned, and Samsung, the company familiar to the modern narrator.
findings.rationale: The repeated 삼성이 그 삼성 contrasts two meanings of the same pronunciation; the existing line conveys only a vague distinction and omits the joke.
findings.replacement:
I meant Samsung,[^1] not the Three Saints, but whatever.

[^1]: The Korean name “Samsung” is pronounced *Samseong*, the same as the Korean term rendered here as “Three Saints.”
findings.source: 이 삼성이 그 삼성이 아니지만 어쨌든.

findings.current: Perhaps the Fire King still wasn’t satisfied.
findings.defect: The draft weakens the specific motive from unappeased anger to generic dissatisfaction.
findings.rationale: 분이 안 풀리다 specifically means that one’s anger has not subsided or been vented, explaining his subsequent year-long assault on the Demonic Cult.
findings.replacement: Perhaps that still hadn’t been enough to quell the Fire King’s anger.
findings.source: 화왕은 그것으로 분이 안 풀렸는지 일 년 동안 눈에 보이는 마교도들을 전부 박살 내고 다시 은거했으니까.

findings.current: he had more than enough strength to return to the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: “More than enough” increases the stated degree of recovery; the source says his energy was sufficient.
findings.rationale: 충분했다 establishes sufficiency, not a surplus, while the preceding clause emphasizes that he remained incompletely recovered.
findings.replacement: he had enough strength to return to the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.source: 태원진가로 복귀할 수 있을 만한 기력은 충분했다.

findings.current: She had come out ahead of time to see us off.
findings.defect: The pronoun’s immediate antecedent in English is the female Lower District Sect coachman, incorrectly assigning Wolhwa’s action and ensuing dialogue to her.
findings.rationale: 그녀 refers to Wolhwa, who is present to see the group off and speaks in the following paragraph; naming her removes the erroneous English antecedent.
findings.replacement: Wolhwa had come out ahead of time to see us off.
findings.source: 그녀는 우리를 배웅하기 위해 먼저 나와 있었다.

findings.defect: The draft replaces Taekyung’s direct, vulgar insult with an explanatory complaint about Mujin’s attitude, softening both the profanity and the comic reaction.
findings.rationale: 이 새끼가 is a blunt insult directed at Mujin; it does not explicitly mention his attitude.

summary: Several actionable fidelity and register issues, including a misassigned subject, altered proficiency, reversed gratitude, lost wordplay, and changed profanity.
